metadata.title: These AI Companies Have Little to Fear From Coming Regulation<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
These AI Companies Have Little to Fear From Coming Regulation
National security concerns are driving the White House to keep a closer eye on artificial-intelligence companies’ most advanced models. But the companies that supply the massive computing power needed for AI have little to fear.
